t: The Nebo CurvBeam 600 Flex is a versatile rechargeable LED headlamp, offering both a powerful spotlight and an ultra-wide 180-degree flood beam for comprehensive hands-free illumination. Engineered for tradespeople and demanding DIY projects, this head torch is ideal for electricians, plumbers, and general site work, providing clear vision in dark environments. Its comfortable, low-profile design features BackBalance Fit, positioning the integrated Li-Ion battery at the rear for superior weight distribution and a secure fit. With dimmable light functions, IPX4 water-resistance, and drop impact-resistance, this robust work light is built for durability indoors and outdoors. A full charge delivers up to 5.5 hours of reliable light.
